about: Packages SKM1-SKM3: skill worth by many methods vs today's price, Maps 0-20 skills. worth / price in budget points (cap-1 (3A + H) x m + S). Verdict cheap = under-priced. Measurement only: nothing applied. tools/skm/summary.js

games.rule: sim rows of today's game; of SKM2's game 6926772d4855 (only road decks changed since: every design but D1 plays the same games); of SKM1's game 8b6f2a672f5f except the STALE skills; per method and skill the newest

rules.verdict: cheap / dear: 3+ kinds and more than half of the kinds with an estimate 25%+ of max(|price|, 1) above / below the price, on calibrated values (a kind = the median of its families, a family = the median of its estimators); else fair
rules.circular: O-hedonic-*, O-measuredS, O-canon listed, not in the consensus
rules.components: OR-*, DR-* (one half each) listed; OD-sum (their sum) votes as the kind race

methods.name: RR stat probes
methods.idea: round robin on equal bodies: 20 farm-dogs given each skill, a canon anchor or a stat bump, every pair against every other; only the games against the six stat entrants: a logistic line through them, h* where the score crosses 1/2

methods.name: RR Bradley-Terry strength

methods.name: RR mean margin
methods.idea: round robin on equal bodies: 20 farm-dogs given each skill, a canon anchor or a stat bump, every pair against every other; the mean bramble margin against every other entrant, in points by the stat entrants' line

methods.name: RR mean score
